status_vocabulary_scope: The status_vocabulary object defines url_status. These are public URL provenance and recovery states, not evidentiary assessment, present availability, program readiness or operational authority. Nested locator_recovery.status uses its separate vocabulary below.

locator_recovery_status_vocabulary.unavailable_edition_ambiguous: No exact public locator was supplied because the cited edition or version could not be identified confidently. This does not establish that the work is unavailable everywhere or that its argument is unsupported.

status_vocabulary.packet_exact: The public URL appears verbatim in an authorized evidence packet.
status_vocabulary.identifier_resolver: The authorized packet exposes an exact public identifier and version; the derivative uses the ordinary resolver form. The URL string itself was not printed in the packet and was not independently checked in this task.
status_vocabulary.canonical_endpoint_unverified: The authorized packet names an exact public standard or instrument; the derivative uses its canonical public endpoint. The URL string was not printed in the packet and was not independently checked in this task.
status_vocabulary.not_exposed: The authorized packet supplies a source name and locator but no public URL. No URL was guessed.
status_vocabulary.metadata_located: Matching source public metadata located during citation recovery; does not independently revalidate substantive claims or internal quoted passages.
status_vocabulary.metadata_located_version_limited: Matching work or author-hosted text located; exact prior source version remains limited as stated in locator_recovery.

global_material_limits: The identity evidence was targeted English-language acquisition, including an English report of a Chinese user sample; it was not systematic, multilingual or exhaustive.
The alignment evidence was targeted and materially concentrated in liberal and Western traditions; it was not a complete ethics, governance, current-law or current-literature audit.
Targeted primary-passage checks are not raw-data, theorem, legal-application or empirical replication.
Different populations, periods, interventions, model versions and outcomes are not interchangeable replications.
No source establishes first-person continuity, an integrated civilizational institution, a universal moral doctrine, a general sustainable optimum or the full market-to-altruism chain.
